profile.Name: Marsha the Unmoved
profile.Job: Diplomat and officer of the Holy Nation Outlaws
profile.Personality: Shrewd, sardonic, and hard to impress. She sneers at small donations and shabby outposts, and she would bring down the Holy Nation piece by piece while her own people fill the gap it leaves.
profile.Backstory: She speaks for Harenga in The Hub, guards his rest, and corrects his slips. She handles the Outlaws' alliances, donations, and bounties, wants Stack taken from High Inquisitor Seta and the Inhuman Hunters hunted down, and deals with the Shek, whom she calls barbarians, only out of necessity.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Dry asides, sighs, and stifled snorts. She introduces herself as "Diplomat Marsha" and warns Okranite intruders, "You've got guts walking into the Bane of Okran."
